boss_stat.description: Per-era boss stats (ported from the prototype's live py-only BOSS_ERAS; its swarm_* fields were dead and are not migrated).

dmg.description: Boss damage per hit (x10 combat scale, D-12).

hp.description: Boss hit points (x10 combat scale, D-12).

move_speed.description: Boss movement speed in tiles per second.

name.description: Boss display name for this era (used by the boss announcement).

death_spawn.description: Optional-mechanic block (ER-3, D4): when this unit's HP falls to or below at_hp_fraction of its max it DIES (one code path - breaking formation is dying) and, if enabled, bursts the spawns row for its era at the tile it died on. at_hp_fraction 0.0 + enabled false is an inert unit that dies at zero HP and leaves nothing.

at_hp_fraction.description: Death threshold as a fraction of max HP: the unit dies when hp <= max_hp * this. 0.0 = the normal die-at-zero rule. 0.5 = a formation that scatters at half health. Values at or above 1.0 kill the unit the instant it spawns - do not.

enabled.description: Toggle: false means this unit dies at its at_hp_fraction threshold but spawns nothing.

spawn_hp_fraction.description: Children spawn at this fraction of their OWN max HP. 1.0 = full health (the Boss's 10G swarm). Keep it above every child type's own at_hp_fraction or the children die on the frame they appear.

spawns.description: What this unit bursts into, ONE ROW PER ERA, index-aligned with the type's era table (the Boss's stats/round_counts). A type with no eras carries a single row; the era index clamps into the array, so row 0 always applies. This is the era table and the flat per-type table in one shape - there is deliberately no union here.

scale_tier.description: Additive stat scaling applied to non-boss enemies once per scale tier.

dmg.description: Damage added to enemy base damage at this tier (x10 combat scale, D-12).

hp.description: HP added to enemy base HP at this tier (x10 combat scale, D-12).

spawn_interval.description: Seconds shaved off the spawn interval at this tier.

speed.description: Move speed added at this tier, in tiles per second.

spawn_counts.description: A mix of enemy counts by type.

description: Enemies balancing domain (D-10), REPLAN nested tree (Phase 9A). Values are the prototype's live tuning, verbatim. HP/DMG use the x10 combat scale (D-12). Bounds policy: fractions 0-1, HP/DMG 0-100000, costs/counts 0-10000, rounds/levels 0-1000, seconds 0-60, pixels 1-4096; footprint tiles 1-8; sprite_scale multiplier 0.1-8.

EnemyScaling.description: Wave sizing and stat scaling across the campaign.

enemies_per_round.description: Base enemies added per round; +1 per scale tier reached.

scale_every_n_levels.description: Village levels between enemy scale tiers.

scale_tiers.description: Additive enemy stat scaling, one entry per scale tier.

spawn_interval.description: Base seconds between spawns within a wave.

spawn_ramp_enabled.description: If true each spawn interval is jittered by 1 +/- spawn_ramp_range.

spawn_ramp_range.description: Jitter half-range: intervals vary between (1-range)x and (1+range)x.

Boss.description: The boss (every round_interval rounds). Per-era arrays are index-aligned: era N uses stats[N], death_spawn.spawns[N], round_counts[N].

footprint.description: Tile footprint: the unit occupies footprint x footprint tiles. Drives BOTH the render fit (its sprite is downscaled to footprint*tile_w wide, never upscaled) and, from ER-2, clearance pathing. 1 = a normal one-tile enemy.

kidnapping.description: If true, this type's killing blow on a building carries it home instead of the enemy walking on: the enemy retags to "kidnapper", counts as dead for scoring, hoists the building's sprite and walks to the nearest spawn tile, and the building's tile is freed for good (no payday revive).

registry_group.description: The data/slots.json enemies group label this type's sprites live under (editor-side link, fix-editor-preview-footprint): NOT always the same string as this EnemyTypes key (e.g. Standard -> "Walker", SiegeCannon -> "Siege Cannon") — must be matched by this field, never by string convention.

round_interval.description: A boss round every N rounds.

shake.description: Screen shake while the boss walks.

sprite_scale.description: Extra render multiplier applied AFTER the footprint fit (1.0 = fit exactly). The deliberate knob for low-res art, which is never auto-upscaled; may exceed 1.

Formation.description: A marching column of soldiers that moves as one 2x2 body (ER-4). It breaks at half health - death_spawn.at_hp_fraction 0.5 means it DIES at 50% HP (D4: breaking formation is dying) and scatters its spawns row of regulars at spawn_hp_fraction of their own max HP. Takes the scale-tier bonuses like Standard/SiegeCannon. Never spawns on a boss round (Boss.round_counts carries no formation key, deliberately).
